warmup._README: Conservative per-day NEW-enrollment cap during fnasr.com mailbox warm-up. The bulk route /api/mond/enroll-apollo-bulk clamps maxPerDay to the segment warmupMaxPerDay while warmup.active is true. Each new enrollment sends step 1 that day, so new-enrollments per day approximates daily send volume during warm-up. Owner: also confirm the Apollo mailbox fn@fnasr.com daily send limit matches (Apollo Settings Mailboxes). Ramp guidance: keep these caps until roughly 200 verified prospects have moved through without deliverability issues, then set warmup.active to false to release the clamp.
